text: Mayor Anderson and council members, good evening. Can everybody hear me? Very good, thank you. So let me get the share screen going. That is roughly on par with the last two years as far as the total numbers, most of which you can see were just physical strength. And then you can go on down the line and see the types of force that have been used and over the first six months. OC spray, that's pepper spray. I've heard discussions recently about people referring to CS gas or OC or pepper spray. And I can tell you, we don't use CS in the field. It's strictly OC or pepper spray. So it's, we have it as an option, but it does not get used very often. One of the things that I've talked about also in my annual report for the past few years is putting our uses of force in context with comparing it to our total number of arrests and total calls for service. text: Well, I'm joining you from foggy ocean shores. It was sunny today, but the fog rolled in. Couple of comments related to things that came up today.
